name: Japanese
notes: Ten courses beyond JPNS 101-102: two foundation, four core language, four electives.
The four core language courses must be CONSECUTIVE from JPNS 151, 152, 201, 202, 205, 206 - consecutiveness is not auto-enforced.
Two of the four electives must be 4-credit upper-level (200-level) JPNS culture courses. One pair of two-credit courses (JPNS 114, 115, 203, 204) may substitute for one culture course.
Up to two courses per semester of education abroad in Japan may apply, pre-approved by an advisor; up to two transfer courses may apply.

requirementGroups.label: Foundation courses (fulfil upper-level writing)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: FOUNDATION COURSES (fulfills upper level writing): CLTR 200: Topics in Critical Thinking; CLTR 389: MLC Research Seminar

requirementGroups.label: Core Japanese language courses (4)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: CORE COURSES: Four consecutive courses in Japanese language from the following list: JPNS 151, 152, 201, 202, 205 and 206.

requirementGroups.label: Upper-level Japanese culture courses (2)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: A minimum of four additional courses in Japanese language or culture, two of which must be 4.0 credit upper-level (200 level) JPNS courses in Japanese culture.

requirementGroups.label: Further Japanese electives (2)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: A minimum of four additional courses in Japanese language or culture
